queries.query: Villavicencio Colombia cadastral map parcel viewer official IGAC geoportal
queries.result: Found official Alcaldía de Villavicencio announcement describing the public catastral dissemination portal, and an anonymous ArcGIS FeatureServer titled U_TERRENO with the service description 'Terrenos catastrales del municipio de Villavicencio'.

queries.query: Villavicencio Colombia visor mapa predial catastro oficial datos abiertos
queries.result: Encontrado el portal oficial de difusión catastral de la Alcaldía; la Alcaldía identifica a Villavicencio como gestor catastral y describe consultas de cédulas catastrales, áreas y otras características prediales. También se encontró el servicio ArcGIS público U_TERRENO.

sources.observed: The municipality states that its Secretaría de Catastro y Espacio Público operates a free geographic information system and catastral consultation portal.
Feature layer U_TERRENO; polygon geometry; native spatial reference EPSG:3116; public anonymous query accepted.
IGAC states that Villavicencio became a cadastral manager; this is corroboration, not a substitute for the local service evidence.

exactPointQuery.request: GET /FeatureServer/1/query with geometry point EPSG:3116, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects, where=1=1, outFields=OBJECTID,CODIGO,GLOBALID,GLOBALID_SNC,codigo_municipio, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326, resultRecordCount=3
exactPointQuery.note: This exact-point hit is evidence of local availability only; it is not used as a citywide coverage estimate.

nearbyEnvelopeQuery.note: Bounded result capped at three features; no broader harvest attempted.
